papers.title: Thermodynamic assessment of the Eu–Sn system
A reinvestigation of the ScIn system and related (Tm,Lu)In compounds

Conclusions All of the experimental phase equilibria and thermodynamic data of the Eu–Sn system from the available literature have been critically evaluated. Within the regime of CALPHAD technique, the thermodynamic models for all the solution phases and the intermetallic compounds are selected and the Gibbs energy functions are optimized.
